{{Quote|Our friends from the Trade Federation have pledged their support, and when their battle droids are combined with yours, we will have an army greater than any in the Galaxy.|Count Dooku|<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" />}}
The '''Separatist Council''', also known as the '''Council of Separatists''', the '''Separatist Union''', or the '''Leadership Council''', was the quasi-executive corps in charge of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Confederacy itself, which was seeking to leave the former. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] originally summoned wealthy businesspeople to the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where they formed a pact with a common goal: to create a "new" governing body for the galaxy and obliterate the Republic. The members of the Council participated actively during the war, leading brigades of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] against the forces of the Republic, though mainly to further their own ends.

During the course of the war, bounties were placed on the Council members' heads, which led to their rendezvous at the planet [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]]. Shortly after, however, the public leader and Head of the Council, Dooku, died at the hands of the young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The Council was placed under the personal protection of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Supreme Commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. The Council members, along with Grievous, were relocated to the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] due to security issues, but were discovered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th attack battalion]].

[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] ordered the Council relocated to the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], prior to a major [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|battle]] on the planet. The Council departed, and Grievous was killed by Kenobi in the midst of the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|battle]]. [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] became Head of the Council, and he and the rest of the corporate conglomerates were placed in charge of the Confederacy. The Separatist Council was ultimately betrayed by Sidious, who sent Vader (formerly Skywalker who turned to the dark side and became Sidious's apprentice) to eliminate them for good. It was on Mustafar that the members of the Separatist Council were massacred one by one by the vengeful Sith Lord.

==History==
===Pre-War and Geonosis===
{{Quote|As I explained to you earlier, I'm quite convinced that ten thousand more systems will rally to our cause with your support. And let me remind you of our absolute commitment to capitalism&hellip; to the lower taxes, the reduced tariffs, and the eventual abolition of all trade barriers. Signing this treaty will bring you profits beyond your wildest imagination. What we are proposing is complete free trade.|Count Dooku, to the Separatist Council|<ref name="AOTC novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
With [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] political ambition to create a separate galactic body opposite the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the dominant [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government of the time, many of the galaxy's largest financial and political benefactors decided to join Dooku's movement under the lure of free trade zones. These included [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]; [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]], [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]; [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]; [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] of the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]]; [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], the [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]; [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] of the [[Hyper-Communications Cartel/Legends|Hyper-Communications Cartel]]; [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] of [[Geonosian Industries/Legends|Geonosian Industries]]; and [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]].<ref name="AOTC novel" />

[[File:GeonosianWarRoom-AotC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Separatist Council on Geonosis.]]
These individuals and several others were summoned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where they would formally agree to help the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist movement]] and organize an army to destroy the Republic.<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" /> Dooku promised a future totally devoted to [[Capitalism/Legends|capitalism]] in which the companies would see great profits.<ref name="AOTC novel" /> Despite making a deal with the Confederacy, major businesses involved would also keep up deals with the Republic so as to profit off both sides in the brewing war.<ref name="Umbara Commentary">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Four]], "Darkened World of Umbara" Commentary</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived on Geonosis before being captured and imprisoned, though he discovered Dooku's plot before being apprehended. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] promptly proceeded to Geonosis in an attempt to rescue Kenobi, though were also apprehended by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] shortly after their arrival.<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" />

The Council attended the trial of Amidala and Skywalker shortly before the duo and Master Kenobi were sentenced to death in the [[Petranaki arena]]. The Jedi and the Senator managed to survive, however, and were reinforced by approximately 200 Jedi under the leadership of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and a large number of clone troopers. This [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] started the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], sealing the fate of the newly formed Separatist Council and ensuring that their loyalties lay with Dooku.<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" />

===Councilors during the War===
{{Quote|Droid, is the planet Ryloth one of our targeted worlds?''"<br />"''Yes, Emir. Based on resources, accessibility, political influence and overall strategic value, it is currently ranked as number seventy-nine.''"<br />"''Mobilize our troops. We are moving it to number one.|Wat Tambor and TA-175|<ref name="Covetous">''[[The Clone Wars: Covetous]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Tambor_on_Ryloth.png|thumb|right|250px|Emir Wat Tambor, on the surface of newly-conquered Ryloth.]]
Nute Gunray continued to attempt to assassinate Padmé Amidala, with an attempt to persuade [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia's]] senator, [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], to give her to Gunray for execution in exchange for food and supplies for Farr's people. The attempt failed, and Gunray was captured by the Republic,<ref name="Bombad Jedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> though he was [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|rescued]] shortly after his capture, from the assistance of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Faro Argyus/Legends|Faro Argyus]].<ref name="COD">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref> Later in the war, Gunray attempted to hold [[Nute Gunray's citadel|his citadel]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

Council members Wat Tambor and Passel Argente spied on each other, as they both grew to mistrust each other.<ref name="Discount">''[[The Clone Wars: Discount]]''</ref><ref name="Covetous" /> Using Argente's suspiciousness to his own advantage, Tambor knew that Argente would seek out a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] droid to utilize against Tambor from the dealer [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]], so Tambor paid Nachkt to sell a spy [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|droid]] to the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]]. As Tambor had predicted, Argente contacted Nachkt, and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] dealer dutifully sold Tambor's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] to Argente. Once the Koorivar had the droid, Nachkt contacted Tambor, and the Skakoan transmitted the dealer's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|reward]] to him. Tambor tuned into the droid's frequency, allowing the Foreman to directly spy on Argente and track his movements across the galaxy.<ref name="Discount" /> As Tambor tracked Argente's movements, the Koorivar traveled to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to meet with [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] broker [[Artruk]], whom Argente had hired to conceal treasures in his possession. Upon noticing the treasures,<ref name="Covetous" /> Tambor ordered his personal [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], [[TA-175/Legends|TA-175]],<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode021.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> to move Ryloth to the highest priority for a Confederate invasion.<ref name="Covetous" />

With Dooku's support and approval,<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Tambor soon invaded Ryloth, starving and subjugating the Twi'lek population to a harsh rule.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> After annihilating the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] defending Ryloth,<ref name="Supply Lines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref> the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] Ryloth, placing [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] in charge of the Confederate fleet,<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> while Tambor made headquarters for himself in Ryloth's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city, [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]].<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> The Republic eventually returned to Ryloth, successfully defeating the [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|blockade]],<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> and landing their troops on the surface for an attack on the capital.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> In a holographic conference with Tambor, Count Dooku, displeased with the Emir's weakening hold on Ryloth, ordered him to salvage what he could of the Twi'lek treasures on the planet and retreat before Windu arrived with his forces in Lessu. Dooku also ordered Tambor to liquidate whatever he could of Ryloth, as the massacre would show the galaxy the "cost" of a Republic victory.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

To accomplish this, Tambor dispatched a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]]<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />&mdash;and, at TA-175's recommendation, an army of ground forces<ref name="Ryloth: Republic Defender">{{TCWA|Republic Defender}} {{C|"Hasbro Biggest Battles: Ryloth" promotion}}</ref>&mdash;to begin destroying several Twi'lek villages in the area. However, Windu soon enlisted the help of the Twi'lek leader [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] and Ryloth's [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|resistance]] against the Confederate oppression. Tambor decided to wait for the last of several [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] hauling the treasures, despite Dooku's order to retreat and bomb Lessu. TA-175, too impatient to wait for his master, departed aboard Tambor's [[Wat Tambor's Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], and the Skakoan was left stranded just as the Republic forces arrived in the city. Windu cornered Tambor; however, Dooku was intent on eliminating Lessu, even with Tambor's life in jeopardy. The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] ordered TA-175 to continue with the bombers' attack, but the intervention of Skywalker and Tano in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|fighters]] prevented the destruction of Lessu. Tambor surrendered and was taken into Republic custody.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

With Geonosis, along with other worlds, secured again for the Separatists,<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] Poggle the Lesser made a deal with the Trade Federation and the Banking Clan to fund a new factory complex on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Poggle was present at a meeting on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] along with Senators [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] and [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]]. However, Clovis brought with him Senator Amidala, who managed to steal the plans to the new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid foundry]] and deliver it to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="Senate Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref> It wasn't long before the Jedi arrived to shut down the new factories on Geonosis. While Poggle remained inside to oversee production, [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|Geonosian warriors]] defended the ray-shielded factory from an offensive strike led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] Skywalker, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]].<ref name="Weapons Factory">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>

During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]], Poggle's aide [[TX-21/Legends|TX-21]] informed him the factory was operating at 50% capacity and had produced ten garrisons of droid troops. In response to the show of force at the bridge near the factory, Poggle authorized twenty of his new ray-shielded [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tanks]] to be deployed, which forced the Jedi forces to fall back. Meanwhile, inside the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]], Ahsoka and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] accidentally woke a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] spy, who quickly informed Poggle of their intrusion. While the two [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] planted explosives in the reactor room, Poggle and TX-21 arrived with a super tank and several Geonosian warriors. Poggle left them to deal with the intruders and the explosives were quickly disable, though TX-21 was destroyed by a detonator placed on the super tank&ndash;which remained unharmed.<ref name="Weapons Factory" />

Councilors San Hill and Shu Mai attempted to hold [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 4">{{CW|4}}</ref> and [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]],<ref name="Reversal of Fortune">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref> respectively. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] of [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], however, now a Councilor, abused her position on the Council to make slave trade easier and far more profitable for her organization. She invited fellow Council members Wat Tambor and Shu Mai to a live auction on her homeland and territory, Zygerria, eventually enslaving Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker. When ordered to kill her new bodyguard, she disobeyed, which led to her death at the hands of Count Dooku.<ref name="The Clone Wars 5">[[The Clone Wars 5|''The Clone Wars'' 5]]</ref>

Bounties were also placed on the Separatist Council member's heads by various high-ranking officials within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], none of which proved any fruit.<ref name="Hunted">''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]''</ref>

===Belderone and Utapau===
{{Quote|What world will accept us now?''"<br />"''If none offers, Chairman, then I will take one|San Hill and Grievous on finding a new haven|<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />}}
In the final stages of the Clone Wars, the Council was to hide in the Outer Rim on [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] orders, due to Republic victories at Separatist strongholds in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray traveled to Cato Neimoidia before it fell to purge his citadel of any remaining treasures he "could not live without," before [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] took the system. In his haste to evacuate, Gunray accidentally left his [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]] behind&mdash;which held vital Separatist information and holo-transmissions regarding the Council's whereabouts. Gunray and his assistant [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] arrived at Grievous's ship, [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], to find that Grievous had already uncovered the Neimoidian's fumble.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />

A quick change of plans was made, and the Council was moved to the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. Before Grievous's death, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] ordered Grievous to send the Council from Utapau to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], supposedly to keep them safe from the Republic, as troops led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Obi-Wan Kenobi were soon to storm the sinkhole planet. However, the Council was doomed to die on Mustafar. Grievous briefed the Council on their travel arrangements shortly after Kenobi arrived; Kenobi was, however, able to eavesdrop on Grievous and the Council, though he let the Council members' retreat before challenging Grievous. [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] soon arrived, bringing Republic clone troopers with him, and engaged the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces. In the midst of the skirmish, Kenobi killed Grievous.<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />

===Death of the Council===
{{Quote|The war is over. Lord Sidious promised us peace! We only want&mdash;|Nute Gunray's last words to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|audio=NuteGunraysLastWords.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />}}
{{Main|Mission to Mustafar/Legends}}
[[File:Sep_council_sidious.png|thumb|left|250px|The Separatist Council on Mustafar shortly before their death.]]
The Separatist Council established their makeshift headquarters in the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]] after being sent to Mustafar by Darth Sidious. Upon Grievous's death at the hands of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the Council assumed direct control of the Confederacy, and began monitoring the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], which they were mostly losing. Sidious then tasked his new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], Darth Vader, with the assassination of all ten Council members, as well as their many aides, after Sidious no longer had any need for the Separatist Movement. Through a hologram, Sidious tells the Separatists that Vader would take care of them, though the Separatists were unaware that Sidious had betrayed them. With Sidious's puppets, the Jedi and the last remaining Separatists dead, Sidious would have little opponents to challenge his [[Declaration of a New Order|rule as Emperor]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />
Vader swiftly traveled to Mustafar, and once inside their hidden command center, was greeted by Gunray and the other council members. Vader trapped the Separatist leaders in their own [[Separatist Council war room/Legends|war room]] and [[Separatist Council Conference Room/Legends|conference room]] before murdering the leaders methodically, killing [[Denaria Kee/Legends|Denaria Kee]], [[Aito Laff]], [[Unidentified Aqualish aide|Nudo's aide]], [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], [[Nank Tun/Legends|Po Nudo's Shi'ido aide]], [[Cat Miin/Legends|Cat Miin]], [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]], [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]], [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] and [[Aruteous Gunnay]] in the War Room, and proceeded to the conference room. There, he killed [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], and, finally, [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], whom Vader held a grudge with for Gunray's attempts to assassinate his secret wife, Amidala.<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />

The Command Center was later host to a [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] between Darth Vader and his former Jedi Master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, where Kenobi saw the Council's bodies and the length of the terror his former pupil had created. With the death of the Council, the Clone Wars officially came to an end, bringing about the age of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />

===Post-War===
Many of the businesses involved in the CIS faded into oblivion after their Head's death, while others were forced to turn their assets over to the newly-formed Galactic Empire. The IG Banking Clan, however, survived the incident, though they were much less profitable than they were before the War.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

==Powers==
The Separatist Council was the governing body of the Confederacy that was led by the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]]-Count Dooku.<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />

Though the Council members were able to contribute to the war effort in almost any way they pleased, they were required to follow orders given by Count Dooku or Darth Sidious, the Sith conspirators behind the war. Miraj Scintel, slave trader and Queen of Zygerria, was unwilling to follow her superior's orders. She was promptly killed by Count Dooku for her misconduct.<ref name="The Clone Wars 5" />

==Composition==
The Council was composed of representatives of Separatist-allied worlds and quasi-government entities. It was chaired by a Head of State.<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" />

The members of the Council were as follows:
*[[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]]&mdash;[[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" /><ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />
*[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;[[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]]<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />
